description: The Doctor confirms the medical angle and points toward the late-night store.

nodes.speaker: doctor
nodes.text: If you are here for aspirin, take a number. If you are here for trouble, you are already next.

options.text: What kind of medicine disappears this late?
You look like you have seen worse nights.

nodes.speaker: doctor
nodes.text: Yeah. Mine. Blondie was not shopping for vitamins. Whoever crossed her path was circling sedatives, not comfort.

options.text: Where do people keep moving after this place closes?

nodes.speaker: doctor
nodes.text: If you need cigarettes, gossip, or somebody still awake enough to notice faces, Jenny keeps the Store open deeper into the night than I do.

nodes.speaker: doctor
nodes.text: Sleep aids, downers, the usual quiet poisons people call treatment when they are trying not to say control.

nodes.speaker: doctor
nodes.text: Worse nights keep my lights on. Better ones never arrive.

conditionalFollowups.speaker: doctor
conditionalFollowups.text: I already told you what matters. Blondie brushed against sedatives, and Jenny's Store is still open if you need the next witness awake.
